cues.en: It's happening.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: Our next developer fundamentals and that is what is good code.
cues.zh: 下一個開發者基本功：什麼是好程式碼？

cues.en: I mean, what is good that seems so vague, right?
cues.zh: 「好」是什麼意思？很模糊，對吧？

cues.en: Like when somebody says I'm a good coder, I'm an excellent programmer, he's a senior programmer, he's an expert programmer.
cues.zh: 有人說自己是優秀的程式設計師、很厲害，是資深工程師、專家，

cues.en: He's a tech lead.
cues.zh: 是技術負責人，

cues.en: He's a genius.
cues.zh: 是天才。

cues.en: What what does that really mean?
cues.zh: 到底代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, you can narrow it down to these simple statements.
cues.zh: 可以歸納成以下簡單敘述。

cues.en: What is clean, good code?
cues.zh: 什麼是乾淨、好的程式碼？

cues.en: I kind of gave it away.
cues.zh: 我好像已經透露了。

cues.en: The first one is clean.
cues.zh: 第一，就是乾淨。

cues.en: That is, we want to make sure our code is following a style that, let's say the Python community endorses.
cues.zh: 確保程式遵循某種風格，例如 Python 社群認可的風格。

cues.en: Are we following the best practices?
cues.zh: 有遵循最佳實務嗎？

cues.en: And Python has this great feature of format, and Python has standard ways of using spaces to make sure
cues.zh: Python 的工具有很棒的格式化功能，也有空白的標準用法，確保

cues.en: that our code is clean.
cues.zh: 程式乾淨。

cues.en: I'm not using unnecessarily ugly spaces like this, or maybe making lists really weird and funky.
cues.zh: 不使用這種多餘、難看的空白，也不把串列寫得奇奇怪怪。

cues.en: Maybe no spaces in between here.
cues.zh: 也許這裡該有空白卻沒加，

cues.en: Maybe.
cues.zh: 或者，

cues.en: I have a lot of random comments over here.
cues.zh: 這裡有一堆隨意的註解。

cues.en: We're keeping our code clean.
cues.zh: 我們要保持程式乾淨。

cues.en: We make sure that every line that we have is easily readable, but also we don't have any extra stuff
cues.zh: 確保每行容易讀，也不要有

cues.en: that we don't need in there.
cues.zh: 不需要的多餘內容。

cues.en: And this also relates to the idea of readability.
cues.zh: 這也關係到可讀性。

cues.en: Now, readability means the ability to want to read your own code.
cues.zh: 可讀性，就是你願不願意讀自己的程式。

cues.en: Maybe two years down the road, you're going to come back and look at the code.
cues.zh: 也許兩年後回來看，

cues.en: Are you going to be able to understand it?
cues.zh: 還看得懂嗎？

cues.en: If you work in teams or for companies and other coworkers, come and look at your code.
cues.zh: 團隊或公司裡，其他同事來看你的程式，

cues.en: Is it easy to understand?
cues.zh: 容易理解嗎？

cues.en: And here this is obviously personal preference, but most of the time the ideas are are simple.
cues.zh: 這當然有個人偏好，但多數時候，概念很簡單。

cues.en: For example, I'm using names here that make sense.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡用合理的名稱。

cues.en: If I had variable names that don't make sense, it'll be really hard for somebody to read my code.
cues.zh: 如果變數名稱沒意義，別人就很難讀懂。

cues.en: Maybe people will be confused why I have this print statement here.
cues.zh: 也許別人會困惑，為什麼這裡有 print。

cues.en: In that case, maybe I should comment in here being like need a new line after every row.
cues.zh: 這時可以加註解：「每列之後需要換行。」

cues.en: Or maybe they'll be confused why we need this as well.
cues.zh: 也可能不理解，為什麼還需要這個。

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: Depending on your style, you might want to add comments.
cues.zh: 依你的風格，可以適度加註解。

cues.en: Make sure that the naming of your variables are good, and maybe making sure that it's not only you that understands the code.
cues.zh: 確保變數命名良好，不是只有自己看得懂。

cues.en: The other one is the idea of predictability.
cues.zh: 另一點，是可預測性。

cues.en: And this is my favorite one.
cues.zh: 這是我最喜歡的。

cues.en: That is, sometimes people try to be really clever with their code, trying to have the most compact
cues.zh: 有時大家想耍聰明，把程式寫得最精簡，

cues.en: code or using the newest features or some really obscure tools that or functions that are not very common just to look, well, frankly smart.
cues.zh: 使用最新功能、冷門工具，或不常見的函式，只為了看起來很聰明。

cues.en: But you want to have code that makes sense, that does things just one thing really well.
cues.zh: 但你要的是合理的程式，把一件事做好。

cues.en: Now this code is quite small, so it's quite predictable, you know, it just has one pass through and it's easy to predict what's going to happen.
cues.zh: 這段程式很小，所以可預測；只走過一次，很容易預測結果。

cues.en: We're going to print, but as we get more and more into the course, you'll see that our code is going to get larger and larger.
cues.zh: 就是印出圖案。但課程越深入，程式會越來越大。

cues.en: And having predictable, easy to understand code is really important.
cues.zh: 可預測、容易理解，就很重要。

cues.en: And then finally, this is an important principle that you're hear everywhere is d r y do not repeat yourself.
cues.zh: 最後，是到處都會聽到的重要原則：DRY，Don't Repeat Yourself，不要重複自己。

cues.en: You don't want to have code that you're constantly repeating yourself over and over again.
cues.zh: 不要讓程式裡，一直反覆出現同樣內容。

cues.en: This is a small example, but it's very easy as a programmer to say, Oh, I'm going to copy this and then I'm going to run this again so that if I click Run.
cues.zh: 這是小例子，但程式設計師很容易說，把這段複製，再跑一次。按 Run，

cues.en: Look at that.
cues.zh: 看。

cues.en: I have two trees now.
cues.zh: 現在有兩棵樹了。

cues.en: This is amazing.
cues.zh: 太棒了。

cues.en: But maybe that's not the best idea.
cues.zh: 但或許這不是最好的方法。

cues.en: You now have 28 lines of code and people might be confused why we're doing this twice.
cues.zh: 現在有 28 行程式，大家可能不理解為什麼寫兩次。

cues.en: Maybe instead, we want to programmatically have a counter here of maybe saying running this twice or
cues.zh: 也許應該用程式控制，例如計數器，指定執行兩次，

cues.en: maybe using something like functions, which we'll learn later to make sure that we can repeat this process over and over and over.
cues.zh: 或用稍後會學的函式，讓這個過程能反覆執行。

cues.en: Now keep these in the back of your mind because throughout the course we're going to explore these topics.
cues.zh: 先把這些放在心裡，整門課都會探索。

cues.en: But let's say I just came on to this code, and I want you to clean it up a bit.
cues.zh: 假設我剛接觸這段程式，想請你稍微整理。

cues.en: Again, this is just personal preference, but these are some of the things that I would do.
cues.zh: 這是個人偏好，但我會做以下幾件事。

cues.en: One is here pixels equal to one.
cues.zh: 第一，這裡 pixel == 1，

cues.en: Instead, this is kind of confusing.
cues.zh: 我覺得有點多餘。

cues.en: I'm just going to say if there is a pixel here and I know that pixels are either a zero on one, then print here because this is a true value that will just evaluate to true.
cues.zh: 直接寫 if pixel，因為知道像素只有 0 或 1，值為真就印出。

cues.en: So that just kind of cleaned out my code a little bit better.
cues.zh: 這讓程式再簡潔一點。

cues.en: Next, another thing that I might do, maybe I want to make this more extensible, which might mean
cues.zh: 接著，可能想讓它更容易擴充，

cues.en: doing something like let's say fill variable that equals to the star and then maybe empty, which equals
cues.zh: 例如建立 fill 變數，等於星號，再建立 empty，

cues.en: to an empty string and change these to fill.
cues.zh: 放空白字串，再把這些改成 fill

cues.en: And empty.
cues.zh: 和 empty。

cues.en: Now, this is extra line of code.
cues.zh: 雖然增加了幾行，

cues.en: But for example, if we're doing this multiple times instead of perhaps, maybe we're running print over and over and over, or maybe we have another line of print over here.
cues.zh: 但如果多處使用，例如反覆 print，或這裡有另一行 print，

cues.en: And another line of print over here and then maybe another line of print over here that is empty.
cues.zh: 那裡又有一行，還有別的地方印空白，

cues.en: Instead of me having to change five locations here, I can now change just this part.
cues.zh: 就不必改五個位置，只需要改這個部分。

cues.en: And maybe instead of Star, I want to display, I don't know, dollar sign.
cues.zh: 也許不想用星號，改用錢字號。

cues.en: And if I run this.
cues.zh: 執行，

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I get a little different image here.
cues.zh: 得到稍有不同的圖案。

cues.en: But again, I was able to just change the variable and the variable was used to fill out whatever I needed done.
cues.zh: 只改變數，就能讓所有使用它的位置都跟著變。

cues.en: Now, these are all things that you do need a bit of experience to get used to, but we'll hopefully
cues.zh: 這些都需要一些經驗才能習慣，但希望

cues.en: explore this throughout the course, and by the end of it you'll have all these best practices in mind.
cues.zh: 透過課程探索，結束時能把這些最佳實務記在心裡。
